title: High-dimensional Laplace asymptotics up to the concentration threshold
summary: We study high-dimensional Laplace-type integrals $I(λ):=(λ/2π)^{d/2}\int_{\mathbb R^d} g(x)e^{-λf(x)}dx$ in the regime where both $d$ and $λ$ are large. Existing rigorous Laplace-expansion results in growing dimension are largely confined to the "Gaussian-approximation" regime $d^2/λ\to0$, which excludes many practically relevant settings that lie beyond this threshold but still satisfy the concentration condition $d/λ\to0$. We close this gap by deriving an explicit asymptotic expansion for $\log I(λ)$ with quantitative remainder bounds that remain valid throughout this intermediate region,…
